'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Tom Hollingworth DS Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tom Hollingworth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out of the Universe]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/worlds-2014-reset-beta-event-3rd-place-ds-tom-hollingworth-hdadtj/ PC list]
